newsitem.title: GERMANY: West German Q4 GDP flat vs Q3 - Econ Ministry.
newsitem.headline: West German Q4 GDP flat vs Q3 - Econ Ministry.

text.p: The Economics Ministry reported the following economic indicator:
W.GERMAN GDP Q4 96 Q3 96 Q2 96 Q1 96

NOTE - Quarter-on-quarter figures are adjusted for inflation (1991 prices) and for seasonal and calendar factors. They are rounded to the nearest half pct point. The Federal Statistics Office earlier gave the bulk of the third quarter GDP figures. Previously announced data in brackets.
